subject: pol-con
title: POL.CON. ------SOC.RT.
description: Chart on book p. 118 (AE(PD)-6). POL-CON (political consciousness) is the subject; SOC-RT (social reality) is the partner. From the subject: INFO-INTR (information interpretation), INFO-F (information focus) and SPT-DYM (spiritual dynamics). From INFO-INTR: INTR (interpretation), with the (R) prefix, "the reality of". From INFO-F: RT-DYM (reality dynamics). From SPT-DYM: POL-P (political policies). From POL-P: C-CONT (composite continuance). From C-CONT: MT-INFO (multi-information). From MT-INFO: CRTF-D (cross-transfer definitions).
